description: This file contains integration tests for loan product short name validation in the Apache Fineract project. It tests that creating loan products with duplicate short names results in the expected validation error.

classes.name: LoanProductShortNameValidationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating behavior when creating loan products with duplicate short names.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the request specification with authentication headers before each test.

methods.name: createLoanProductsWithSameShortName
methods.description: Test that creating two loan products with the same short name results in a validation error.

methods.name: successResponseSpec
methods.description: Builds and returns a response specification expecting HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: validationFailedResponseSpec
methods.description: Builds and returns a response specification expecting a validation error with a specific error code.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with a provided short name and validate the response.
